name: ONE FAMILY OFFICE
decision_note: Multi-family office and investor club built with the HAVEL & PARTNERS law firm (wealth management, family-structure advice, co-investments) - an investor type outside the VC pilot; no dated direct VC-type investment was found.

legal_entities.name: ONE FAMILY OFFICE Funds Management s.r.o.

evidence.quote: Největší a personálně nejlépe vybavený multi family office v Česku a na Slovensku: téměř 20 mezinárodně zkušených investičních specialistů a cca 50 spolupracujících právních, daňových a účetních poradců
1. investice a správa rodinného majetku, 2. poradenství a ochrana rodinného majetku a 3. concierge – zajištění co nejkvalitnějšího života rodiny.
naše portfolio pravidelně doplňujeme o ty nejzajímavější z nich
Sdružený majetek zakladatelů, partnerů a omezeného okruhu obchodních přátel, kteří se podílí na platformě ONE FAMILY OFFICE, má hodnotu 18 miliard korun

analyst_notes: Self-described multi-family office (offices in Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Bratislava, Košice, Frankfurt, Dubai) whose activities are investment and management of family wealth, advisory/protection of family wealth, and concierge; it offers members co-investment opportunities and says it regularly adds domestic opportunities to its portfolio (e3). Typed family_office (MFO) and excluded as S1; part of the activity is services (could also be read as E1 for the advisory/concierge business). The pooled assets of founders and partners are stated as CZK 18bn (e4) - not a fund size, so capital is left not_disclosed. All site statements are undated, and no dated investment by ONE FAMILY OFFICE was found in the time budget (web search budget was also exhausted). New entities ONE FAMILY OFFICE GP s.r.o. (2026-02-17) and ONE FAMILY OFFICE Funds Management s.r.o. (2026-07-07) suggest fund vehicles are being set up - worth re-screening later.
